turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting, and stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI or ask you to step out of it. Only the words END MEETING, typed on their own line, end the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale, I have until 4:40, so let's not waste it. My son has a zero in your gradebook for an essay he wrote, and he found out on his phone in front of his classmates. Withdraw it, and tell me who decided.
"Over with." Okay. Then answer my question: on what basis did you enter a zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before you did?
Look, your son cheated. Everyone knows it. I'm not wasting my evening on this.
My son doesn't lie, Hale. Are you calling me a liar too? "Everyone knows" isn't a document, so show me what you have, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
You lawyers think you can bully anyone.

I haven't raised my voice, Hale. I've asked you twice what you have, and you've told me nothing. Twelve minutes of my time are gone on this, so show me a document or I'm walking to the principal's office.
Are you going to keep wasting my time?
You asked for this meeting, Hale. If you have something, put it on the desk. If you don't, I'm going upstairs.
